(Search snippet content — AP wire copy carried by PBS/ABC; AP is an approved source)

Andy Burnham was elected leader of the UK's governing Labour Party on Friday 17 July 2026, putting him in line to become prime minister on Monday 20 July, replacing Keir Starmer. He has promised to unite the country and fight off the challenge from Reform UK.

DIRECT QUOTE — Andy Burnham, leadership acceptance speech to Labour MPs and party officials: "We are united, and we put the power that comes from that unity at the service of people and places who have been waiting too long for politics to let them hope again."

DIRECT QUOTE — Andy Burnham: Britain took "a series of wrong turns in the 1980s" when "political power was centralized and economic power privatized."

He highlighted plans to focus on economic renewal, more public control of key sectors, and creating new modern industrial jobs.
